fixtures.name: with green header

options.title: Water abstraction licence
options.text: Apply for a licence to take water from a river, stream, canal or underground source.

fixtures.description: The Defra brand green (#00a33b) in the role the branding guidance sanctions for it — a header band, used sparingly. White on this green is 3.33:1, which conforms because the banded title is large text (19px bold, where the threshold is 3:1 rather than 4.5:1). The size and weight are pinned in CSS for that reason: shrink them and the contrast silently stops conforming.

fixtures.name: with green header and whole card link

options.title: Apply for a water abstraction licence
options.text: For abstractions of more than 20 cubic metres a day.

fixtures.description: A linked heading on the band takes the same white rather than the link green, which would be close to invisible against the brand green. It stays underlined, so it still reads as a link. Focus keeps the upstream yellow block, which reads correctly on the band.
